Vendor-neutral by design

We’re not here to sell you Lyzr. We’re here to help you choose the right agents.

    The Reimaginer, our consultant who maps your process, builds the business case and the agents prove it, so you walk into the steering committee, or your customer’s, with both.

FAQ

Questions buyers ask before they book.

What happens to our data?

We work on sandboxed, synthetic or anonymised data by default. Real data is used only on terms your security team agrees to, and we sign an NDA before you share anything. In production, Lyzr runs in your cloud, on-prem or air-gapped, single tenant, with your keys and your models.

Who owns the agents and the readout?

You keep the business case, the readout and the agents your team drove, whatever you decide. If you choose another vendor, take the readout with you.

Why is the test drive $0?

We would rather you decide on something running than on slides. Three days of our time is a better pitch than a quarter of vendor meetings.

What do you need from us?

A problem statement, about an hour with a process owner, sample or synthetic data, and two or three people who would actually use the agent in the live session.

When do we pay?

Only if you choose Lyzr. Next comes a fixed-scope PoC on your environment, then you pay only for agents in production, with no markup on LLM usage. Larger ideas can run as a four-week paid pilot at $20,000, our cost price.

Who qualifies?

Enterprises with a defined problem statement and a process owner who can give us time. We run a limited number of test drives each month so every one gets the full team.

What are the Reimaginer, Lyzr Architect and Agent Studio?

The Reimaginer is our consultant who maps your process and builds the business case. Lyzr Architect is our no-code agent builder. Agent Studio is our pro-code workbench where engineering teams design, test and ship production agents.

Security and data

Every deployment is single tenant, with your own keys and the models you choose.
